design_philosophy: Clear affordances, large tap targets, horizontal progression (carousels) to reduce vertical scroll fatigue, intuitive Spanish-first labeling.

colors.accents: Electric blue or high-contrast brand color strictly for selections/highlights

layout_strategy.global: Mobile-first priority. Generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6). Avoid long vertical stacking of large items.
layout_strategy.top_navigation: Sticky top header with Shadcn Tabs ('Imagen', 'Video (Reel)', 'Crear con IA'). Use overflow-x-auto so tabs slide sideways if they don't fit on small screens.
layout_strategy.section_1_templates: Horizontal snap carousel replacing the 2-col grid. Use flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory gap-4 pb-4 -mx-4 px-4. Cards show partial next item to indicate scrollability.
layout_strategy.section_2_photos: Square dashed dropzones for 1 or 2 photos. Incorporate the 'Mejorar con IA' button inside the photo frame natively as a floating bottom-right pill.
layout_strategy.section_3_brief: Textarea for '¿Qué quieres comunicar?'. Min 4 rows. Clear distinct label.
layout_strategy.section_4_quick_options: Horizontal scrollable chip lists for 'Formato' (Vertical, Cuadrado) and 'Color' swatches to completely eliminate vertical stacking.
layout_strategy.section_5_advanced: Use a Shadcn Drawer (Bottom Sheet on mobile, Dialog on desktop) for the 'Personalizado' color pickers and 'Idioma del post' toggle. Keeps main feed clean.
layout_strategy.bottom_action: Sticky bottom bar using glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl) housing a large 'Generar Post' button so users never hunt for it.

template_carousel.wrapper: flex w-full overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory gap-4 pb-6 scrollbar-hide
template_carousel.item: flex-none w-[200px] h-[200px] snap-center rounded-2xl border-2 bg-white overflow-hidden relative transition-all duration-200

horizontal_chips.wrapper: flex w-full overflow-x-auto gap-3 pb-4 scrollbar-hide
horizontal_chips.chip: flex-none px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full border text-sm font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer

color_swatches.wrapper: flex w-full overflow-x-auto gap-4 pb-4 scrollbar-hide items-center
color_swatches.swatch: flex-none w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 cursor-pointer shadow-sm transition-transform hover:scale-105
color_swatches.custom_trigger: flex-none w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 bg-slate-50

photo_dropzone.container: w-full aspect-square border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-white relative overflow-hidden group
photo_dropzone.ai_button: absolute bottom-4 right-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md shadow-sm border border-slate-200 text-slate-900 text-xs px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-bold z-10 flex items-center gap-2

bottom_sheet_drawer.usage: Triggered by 'Personalizado' color or 'Más opciones'. Contains Idioma toggle (Inglés/Español) and exact color pickers.

sticky_action_bar.container: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-200 z-50
sticky_action_bar.button: w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold rounded-2xl bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-lg

results_section.layout: Displays generated post with a horizontal carousel if multiple formats are generated. Action buttons (Descargar, Agregar a mi tarjeta) directly below the image preview.
results_section.copy_editor: A card container wrapping editable inputs (Headline, Subheadline, CTA, Caption) with a 'Generar de nuevo' re-render action at the top right of the card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor the /marketing 'Imagen' tab UI to prioritize horizontal scrolling for selectors.
DO NOT REMOVE ANY FUNCTIONALITY. The form state should remain intact (10 templates, 1-2 photos, prompts, English/Spanish toggle, formats, colors).
Replace the tall vertical grid of templates with the `template_carousel` spec.
Replace vertically stacked radio buttons/checkboxes for formats and colors with `horizontal_chips` and `color_swatches`.
Move advanced/secondary choices like 'Idioma del post' and 'Personalizado' color configuration into a Shadcn Drawer/Dialog to save vertical space on mobile.
Implement a custom `scrollbar-hide` CSS class (or use standard Tailwind hiding methods) to keep horizontal scrolling areas clean without a visible track.
Always wrap the 'Generar Post' button in the `sticky_action_bar` layout so it is always accessible on mobile without scrolling to the bottom.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all actionable elements strictly following the component_specs.
